selection: strict validation top1; both inspected and remaining test checked for regressions

dataSource.attribution: Parkhi, Vedaldi, Zisserman, Jawahar. Cats and Dogs. CVPR 2012.

limitations: All available official train images except validation,5 validation,40 test images per breed; not a real-world evaluation.
Backbone was pretrained on pet datasets; overlap with Oxford is not audited.
No identity labels: this does not measure individual animal matching.
No bird/rabbit/hamster, mixed-breed or unknown-image evaluation.
No animal detector crop yet. Exact duplicate removal does not remove all near duplicates.
